title: emg2pose: Surface EMG and Hand Pose
description: This dataset is a NEMAR re-host and EMG-BIDS conversion of the Meta emg2pose benchmark, comprising surface electromyography (sEMG) recordings paired with hand pose labels for hand pose estimation research. It contains 2 kHz, 16-channel wrist sEMG data collected from 193 users across 370 hours and 29 behavioral stages, synchronized with joint-angle labels derived from a 26-camera motion-capture rig, yielding approximately 80 million labeled frames. The dataset supports benchmarking of surface electromyographic methods for estimating hand pose.
methods_description: Surface EMG was recorded at 2 kHz using 16 wrist-mounted channels, paired with hand pose labels captured by a 26-camera motion-capture rig. Joint-angle labels were derived via inverse kinematics and stored as 20 radian-valued joint-angle channels. Upstream HDF5 recordings were converted to EMG-BIDS BDF files using a fast parallel adaptation of the facebookresearch/emg2pose PR #6 approach, with BAD_IK annotations marking samples where inverse-kinematics labels are all zero.
